verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials describe dragging a vendor invoice into Ramp, where it is automatically matched to its PO, coded to the right GL account, routed for approval, and paid. Its agents learn from past invoices and apply that logic during processing, while guardrails state that no money moves without human confirmation and unclear items are flagged for review. missing for 10: explicit documentation that AI extracts payment fields (vendor bank details, amount, due date) from the bill, a detailed bill-OCR or extraction guide, and independent or hands-on corroboration of invoice-parsing accuracy.
